description:
Screens one brand name against trademark registers. No account needed.

    Returns the registered and pending marks closest to the name (up to 25), each with a
    similarity tier, and the registers those marks are filed in. EU marks come from
    EUIPO's search; the other registers are read from Antevo's copy, refreshed from each
    office, so a filing from the last few days can be missing. It is a screen, not
    clearance.
name: screen_mark
title: Screen a brand name
